text:
molly (eng): hey @people-ops — need quick help. I had a podiatry visit on 2026-03-15 at FootCare Center. Provider shows up in the insurer directory as in-network, but my claim (claim# 987654321) came back as OON. I'm on the Core Plus plan (enrolled during OE). Can someone advise next steps?

dean (People Ops): sorry you're dealing with this — can you paste the EOB text (or a photo) and the provider NPI if you have it? also which member ID is on the EOB (last 4 ok).
molly (eng): attaching a pic in the DM — EOB shows: "Provider billed $250, allowed $0, patient responsibility 100%". Member on file ends with 4321. Provider NPI listed on their site is 1234567890.
raj (Benefits): thanks — first check: confirm your plan effective date. OE changes sometimes have a future effective date which can create gaps. What date was your Core Plus effective?
molly (eng): my onboarding email says effective 2026-02-01 (I switched tiers during open enrollment).
ben (Health Plan Liaison): two common causes: 1) provider got the patient's subscriber ID wrong, 2) provider billed under a different NPI/taxonomy. If they're in the directory, we can ask insurer to re-run eligibility for the service date. I can open a case with the carrier if you want us to.
luis (Billing): if the provider resubmits, they should include the rendering NPI and the billing NPI and the CPT code. Example we ask them to use:```service_date: 2026-03-15
claim_id: 987654321
cpt: 11720
rendering_npi: 1234567890
billing_taxonomy: 207Q00000X```That often fixes mismatch denials.
hr-bot: For claim appeals, follow this guide: https://benefits.example.com/claims-appeals — you can upload EOBs and authorize Redwood reps to speak to the insurer via the portal.
dean (People Ops): @ben please open the carrier ticket and cc the provider. @molly we'll need a signed release if you want us to speak on your behalf — can you DM me that? If the effective date is 2026-02-01 we're within the active period.
molly (eng): will DM the release now. also fyi the clinic gave me an itemized receipt I can forward to the provider billing manager.
ben (Health Plan Liaison): opened case with carrier referencing claim 987654321 — case# CP-2026-4112. I'll request an eligibility re-check for 2026-03-15 and ask them to reprocess if it was a system mapping error.
luis (Billing): if carrier says provider billed under an alternate practice NPI, we can ask provider to refile with the practice NPI and include rendering NPI and taxonomy. If they refuse, escalate and we'll prepare appeal language for you.
molly (eng): thanks everyone — appreciate the quick help. I'll DM the release and forward the EOB/photo. :thumbsup:
dean (People Ops): noted — once we have the release and EOB I'll follow up with the carrier and loop you in. If anything looks like a plan admin error we'll correct retroactively. :white_check_mark:
